semiconductor_relevance: High — TeraSolar Energy Materials Corp. specializes in conductive silver pastes and laser equipment, which are critical for high-efficiency solar cell processes and other semiconductor applications.
summary: TeraSolar Energy Materials Corp. focuses on the manufacture and development of conductive silver pastes and laser equipment, particularly for high-efficiency solar cells. The company also provides solutions for passive components, PCBs, and touch panels, along with services for metal additive manufacturing.
capabilities: Conductive silver pastes for solar cells
Manufacturing services for metal additive manufacturing
